items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: It says in John Chilton's book that you originally played drums.

ctx.x: It says in John Chilton's book that you originally played drums.

Yes, with a trumpet band; I played the trumpet and the drums. I used to take dates like that. I had a record player, it even had a straw needle on it and I played the drums with whoever was around on the record or the radio. I played the trumpet at the same time. That all went together.

items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was a British composer... [INTERVIEWEE] I'd love to hear

ctx.x: He was a British composer who wrote some stuff that was really interesting, kind of Ellington influenced, and they recorded it in New York with Benny's band and they brought in Coleman Hawkins. They were some marvelous records.
